svg.desc:
The owner's identity mark, the flat cut. Supplied as personal-brand/logo-17.09/logo-17.09-without-shading.svg. One closed contour, no overlays.
app/globals.css masks the header mark out of this file and paints the box: lemon on a dark chip, ink on the canvas, lighter on hover. The shading is public/mark-shade.svg, a second mask stacked on top in black or white. The mask itself never changes, so a hover only retints and cannot jump.
The tab icon is public/mark-small.svg, which is this contour plus the shading, in one file.
